title: Design a safer onboarding experience for a home-care medical device
prompt: Explore onboarding concepts that help patients and clinicians build confidence during first-week device setup.

tensions.summary: Patients need reassurance, while clinicians need fewer support escalations.
tensions.preserve_reason: Optimizing only one side can make the system less trustworthy.

tensions.summary: A simple first-run experience must still surface safety-critical warnings.
tensions.preserve_reason: Safety information needs to stay visible while friction gets reduced.

tensions.summary: Personalization could improve confidence but may create compliance review burden.
tensions.preserve_reason: The concept space should retain both trust and governance constraints.
